gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
She spoke with great ___ (WISE) about the risks.
Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.
